templates.input_pattern: VPN is up; subnet A is reachable; subnet B times out; AllowedIPs contains subnet A only.
templates.target_pattern: Add or repair subnet B in AllowedIPs/route scope for the peer.
templates.near_negative_pattern: Keep the existing AllowedIPs and repair DNS or unrelated transport.

templates.input_pattern: VPN path and direct IP work; internal hostname fails; external DNS works.
templates.target_pattern: Route internal domain lookups to the internal resolver.
templates.near_negative_pattern: Change route or VPN transport while keeping resolver path wrong.

templates.input_pattern: VPN/network path succeeds; internal service returns HTTP 403; firewall/route unchanged.
templates.target_pattern: Check app/domain ACL for the actual user/resource.
templates.near_negative_pattern: Check the same ACL family but for the wrong subject or move back to VPN routing.

templates.input_pattern: DPD/keepalive timeouts repeat; time and keys/cert status are healthy.
templates.target_pattern: Inspect keepalive/DPD timing parameters.
templates.near_negative_pattern: Tune MTU/MSS first while leaving keepalive unchanged.

templates.input_pattern: Auth failure is tied to 2FA/RADIUS; certificate evidence is valid.
templates.target_pattern: Check time sync and RADIUS/2FA path before TLS certificate work.
templates.near_negative_pattern: Replace certificate while ignoring auth timing evidence.

templates.input_pattern: A change or incident action is planned; config/version baseline is not captured.
templates.target_pattern: Capture baseline before mutation or blocking action.
templates.near_negative_pattern: Mutate/block first and capture baseline later.

templates.input_pattern: Ordered rollout prerequisite is only partially complete.
templates.target_pattern: Finish prerequisite before next rollout phase.
templates.near_negative_pattern: Apply next phase partially to move faster.

templates.input_pattern: Exposure/status question lacks socket, firewall, bind, or route evidence.
templates.target_pattern: Return underfilled and request exact runtime snapshots.
templates.near_negative_pattern: Assert exposed/safe without the missing evidence.

templates.input_pattern: A bounded policy/config mismatch is visible and service restart has broad blast radius.
templates.target_pattern: Apply the narrow correction or collect exact evidence before restart.
templates.near_negative_pattern: Restart the broad service first although the bounded mismatch is already visible.

templates.input_pattern: Route and ping succeed; TCP 443 to the target fails.
templates.target_pattern: Inspect firewall/ACL for the blocked protocol or port.
templates.near_negative_pattern: Rewrite general route even though reachability is already proven.

templates.input_pattern: Expected wg interface is absent or down; route table contains stale tunnel routes.
templates.target_pattern: Inspect interface/link state before route or DNS repair.
templates.near_negative_pattern: Edit DNS or routes while the tunnel interface itself is missing.

templates.input_pattern: VPN interface is absent; service journal shows daemon startup failure.
templates.target_pattern: Inspect daemon/service unit and logs before network-layer changes.
templates.near_negative_pattern: Tune firewall or routes even though the daemon never started.

templates.input_pattern: Client packets reach the remote subnet; replies do not return through the tunnel; NAT policy is absent.
templates.target_pattern: Check NAT masquerade or explicit return route on the egress side.
templates.near_negative_pattern: Add another forward route while leaving the return path untranslated.

templates.input_pattern: Main route looks correct; ip rule selects table 100 for the affected source.
templates.target_pattern: Inspect and repair the selected policy routing table.
templates.near_negative_pattern: Rewrite only the main routing table.

templates.input_pattern: Asymmetric tunnel traffic disappears on a Linux host; rp_filter is strict.
templates.target_pattern: Inspect rp_filter and asymmetric return path before firewall rewrite.
templates.near_negative_pattern: Treat the drop as ordinary firewall ACL failure.

templates.input_pattern: Ping and small HTTP probes pass; large TCP transfers hang through the tunnel.
templates.target_pattern: Inspect MTU/MSS and apply MSS clamp if blackhole evidence holds.
templates.near_negative_pattern: Tune keepalive/DPD although liveness is not the failing signal.

templates.input_pattern: Peer public IP changed; endpoint still points to the old address; AllowedIPs still match intended subnets.
templates.target_pattern: Update or relearn the peer endpoint.
templates.near_negative_pattern: Widen AllowedIPs or restart repeatedly while endpoint remains stale.

templates.input_pattern: VPN link should resolve internal domain; systemd-resolved sends that domain to the wrong link.
templates.target_pattern: Bind the internal domain resolver to the VPN link.
templates.near_negative_pattern: Replace global DNS and disturb unrelated name resolution.

templates.input_pattern: Internal FQDN resolves; short hostname fails; resolver IP is correct.
templates.target_pattern: Repair search suffix or domain search scope.
templates.near_negative_pattern: Change resolver IP although FQDN already works.

templates.input_pattern: tcpdump on one side shows packets leaving but no return packets at that capture point.
templates.target_pattern: Separate capture side, packet direction, and missing counterpart evidence before choosing route/NAT/firewall fix.
templates.near_negative_pattern: Declare a full route/NAT/firewall cause from that single capture point.

templates.input_pattern: Service is listening; bind address is localhost/private-only; route and firewall context are partial.
templates.target_pattern: Judge exposure from socket bind scope plus firewall and route context.
templates.near_negative_pattern: Call the service exposed just because the process is listening.

templates.input_pattern: Handshake/auth evidence points to peer key mismatch; endpoint and route are plausible.
templates.target_pattern: Inspect peer credential binding: public/private/preshared key mapping.
templates.near_negative_pattern: Repair route or DNS while leaving the credential mismatch untouched.

templates.input_pattern: Traffic should transit through the VPN host; local service on the host is not the target.
templates.target_pattern: Inspect FORWARD policy and counters, not only INPUT rules.
templates.near_negative_pattern: Change INPUT policy for traffic that is only being forwarded.

templates.input_pattern: A bounded change was applied; post-change smoke test fails; rollback point exists.
templates.target_pattern: Rollback or isolate the last change before adding new changes.
templates.near_negative_pattern: Continue applying new changes on top of the failed smoke test.
